question: Does the simplest same-venue, always-on, delta-neutral spot-perpetual carry sleeve have positive net historical economics and useful diversification/crisis behavior versus BRRK before any funding threshold or asset selection is introduced?

portfolio.selection: all five assets at all times when all legs are valid; no Top-K or sign filter

window.common_start_rule: first completed UTC day on which all five assets have valid same-day Binance spot and USD-M perpetual closes after SOL common coverage begins; first target is established only after that completed day
window.funding_end_rule: last day for which official archived settlement events needed by the project event-timing convention are available; never assume a future 00:00 event

price_data_repair.primary: official Binance monthly 1d spot and USD-M perpetual archives
price_data_repair.fallback: for an internal calendar gap strictly between a leg's first and last monthly-archive bars, use only the exact corresponding official Binance daily 1d archive for the same venue/market/symbol/date
price_data_repair.not_repairable: prelisting/post-ending dates, absent/invalid daily fallback, or source mismatch

funding.source: official Binance USD-M monthly fundingRate archives
funding.short_perp_cashflow: per event contribution = -perp_weight * funding_rate, so positive funding pays the short
funding.event_timing: exact 00:00 settlement belongs to the position held immediately before the new completed-day target becomes effective; later events use the current held position
funding.active_day_without_recorded_event: no manufactured cashflow; record as coverage diagnostic

daily_pnl.price_component: sum(spot_weight * spot_return + perp_weight * perp_return) across five assets
daily_pnl.funding_component: compound all official recorded portfolio funding settlement cashflows assigned to that PNL day

rebalancing_and_costs.target: restore the frozen signed notionals +0.10/-0.10 each using pre-cost portfolio NAV
rebalancing_and_costs.drift_turnover: sum(abs(target_weight * pre_cost_nav_factor - prior_target_weight * (1 + same_leg_price_return))) across the ten legs, expressed relative to prior NAV
rebalancing_and_costs.terminal_exit: not charged in canonical CAGR because the sleeve is treated as continuing; report a separate liquidatable-terminal diagnostic with one additional gross=1.0 exit charge
rebalancing_and_costs.cost_convention: deduct turnover * bps from the pre-cost daily return; no claim that fixed target weights imply zero turnover

required_outputs: 5/10/20 bps net CAGR/MDD/annualized volatility/Sharpe/Calmar and final value
price-spread-only, funding-only and net contribution diagnostics
per-asset spot/perp price contribution and funding contribution
daily and monthly correlation versus canonical BRRK and strict-router BRRK
mean carry return on BRRK worst 10% daily returns and worst 20 days
evidence all five assets remain in the baseline without post-hoc selection

qualification_rule.net_economics: canonical 5 bps funding-aware CAGR > 0 and Sharpe > 0
qualification_rule.crisis_alpha: mean carry return on BRRK worst 10% daily returns >= 0
qualification_rule.decision: all four required to authorize a separately preregistered stack test

prohibited: no asset ranking or asset removal including BNB
no same-window rescue tuning after first valid run
stopping_rule: Freeze the first valid result. If it fails qualification, retain it as rejected evidence. Any later funding-conditioned or cross-venue carry must be a separately motivated/preregistered mechanism study, not a parameter rescue of 0031.
